generator: HelioSI paper-to-skill factory (Claude Opus 4.7) — wave500 SEP/shocks/space-weather batch
harness_framing: Skills are runtime-neutral and loadable by any general-purpose agent runtime (Claude Code, LingTai, Codex, Cursor, OpenAI Assistants, …). Named runtimes / MCPs / repos appear only as adapter examples. Each SKILL.md exposes four layers — scientific-invariant, executable-protocol (abstract capability contracts), adapter notes (optional), research-generation affordances (§9).

layer_model.1_scientific_invariant: claims, equations, methods, data assumptions, failure modes, figure / numerical targets — runtime-neutral
layer_model.2_executable_protocol: abstract capability contracts (e.g., 'load PSP/IS☉IS L2', 'fit power-law') — not bound to any specific API, MCP, or runtime
layer_model.3_adapter_notes: named tools, MCPs, repos, libraries — example adapters satisfying the contract; substitutable
layer_model.4_research_generation_affordances: gaps, tensions, new hypotheses, follow-up experiments when composed with prior skills in the corpus — see SKILL.md §9

compilation_framing.model: Each paper compiled into a runtime-neutral Skill — claims → verifiable tasks; methods/equations → executable workflows; data/instruments → abstract tool / capability contracts; caveats → skill memory; figures/results → benchmark artifacts; corpus/citations → skill graph (depends_on); plus research-generation affordances (§9 of each SKILL.md).

exclusion_note: Excludes the 12 slugs already in batch_sep_energetic_particles: paper-cuesta-2024-kappa-distributions-energetic-protons, paper-desai-2024-hcs-reconnection-400kev-protons, paper-dresing-2025-widespread-esp-march-2023, paper-jebaraj-2024-synchrotron-electrons-near-sun-shocks, paper-kouloumvakos-2026-iva-shock-properties, paper-laitinen-2026-vda-turbulent-heliosphere, paper-murtas-2024-compression-acceleration-hcs, paper-reames-2026-physics-of-seps, paper-trotta-2025-ip-shock-variability-multi-spacecraft, paper-walker-2026-icme-radial-particle-acceleration-statistics, paper-wimmer-schweingruber-2024-sep-inner-heliosphere-solo-psp, paper-xu-2026-psp-iva-sep-events.

skills.title: Statistical analysis of solar energetic particle rise times using Earth and Mars observations and constraints on particle transport parameters
skills.core_claim: Statistical relationship between SEP rise time at different energies follows a power-law in energy; flatter exponent at Mars implies weaker energy dependence and turbulence-scattering approaching a rigidity-independent regime farther from the Sun.

skills.title: Do Solar Energetic Electrons cross the Heliospheric Current Sheet? — A Statistical Study
skills.core_claim: Opposite-side SEE events (source and observer in different magnetic sectors) are rarer and more isotropic; both source and spacecraft tend to lie closer to the HCS than for same-side events — particle transport across the HCS is inefficient unless source or observer sits near the HCS.

skills.title: Solar Energetic Particle Reflection by Precursor ICMEs: Multi-spacecraft Observations of Bi-Directional Electron Beams at 1 AU
skills.core_claim: Two impulsive SEE events show a primary anti-Sunward beam followed by a Sunward counter-streaming beam; modeled travel path 1–2 au is consistent with reflection off a precursor-ICME shock beyond 1 au; one event also shows inverse velocity dispersion in electrons, the first such detection at 1 au.

skills.title: Solar Energetic Particle Events and Associated Type II Radio Bursts from Different Source Regions
skills.core_claim: Of 43 SEP halo-CMEs vs 131 non-SEP halo-CMEs 2010–2024, almost all SEP and ~2/3 non-SEP events have type II bursts; SEP-associated type IIs have longer duration and lower ending frequency; starting frequency depends on source region (single AR > multi AR > outside AR); proton spectral index anti-correlates with type II starting frequency.

skills.title: 36Cl Concentrations from Polar Ice Cores Set New Constraints on the Carrington Event
skills.core_claim: Two 36Cl records and 10Be data show no significant 1859 enhancement, ruling out an extreme >30 MeV SEP event for the Carrington storm; either the SEP fluence was soft (up to ~3× the largest Space Age event) or there was no Earth-bound SEP.

skills.title: New insights from cross-correlation studies between solar activity indices and cosmic-ray flux during Forbush decrease events
skills.core_claim: Cross-correlation between solar-activity indices (Kp/Dst/sunspot/F10.7/etc.) and GCR flux during Forbush-decrease events reveals lag/structure relationships that constrain how ICME shocks modulate the cosmic-ray flux.

skills.title: The First Four Ground-Level Enhancements in the 1940s: Investigation, Digitisation, and Analysis of Forgotten Data
skills.core_claim: Digitisation and re-analysis of the first four GLEs in the 1940s yields revised GLE intensities and provides forgotten constraints on extreme-event spectra.

skills.title: Anomalous cosmic rays within the inner heliosphere: Observations of helium by the High Energy Telescope onboard Solar Orbiter
skills.core_claim: Solar Orbiter/HET measures ACR helium spectra inside 1 au, constraining inner-heliosphere modulation against the historic IBEX/Voyager picture.

skills.title: Unusual Circumstances of the 2024 June 8 GLE
skills.core_claim: The 2024-06-08 GLE occurred under atypical conditions (e.g. behind-limb / unusual source geometry — TODO_verify); paper unpacks the in-situ + remote-sensing evidence.

skills.title: Evidence that SOL2012-06-03 Late Phase gamma-Rays are Produced by >300 MeV Protons from CME-Shock Acceleration of Suprathermals from the Flare
skills.core_claim: Late-phase gamma-ray emission from SOL2012-06-03 is produced by >300 MeV protons accelerated by the CME-driven shock, drawing on suprathermal flare-accelerated ions as a seed population.

skills.title: A study of solar energetic particle transport on 30 March 2022 using multi-spacecraft data assimilation
skills.core_claim: Data-assimilation of multi-spacecraft SEP intensities for 2022-03-30 yields posterior constraints on parallel + perpendicular diffusion coefficients of the event's transport model.

skills.title: Sunward Streaming 3He-rich SEP Events Observed by Solar Orbiter and Parker Solar Probe during Perihelion Passage
skills.core_claim: PSP and Solar Orbiter observe 3He-rich SEP events near perihelion exhibiting Sunward streaming, indicating reflected / mirrored / backward-streaming behavior beyond canonical impulsive forward-streaming expectations.

skills.title: Three-dimensional properties of a coronal shock and the longitudinal distribution of its related solar energetic particles
skills.core_claim: A 3D coronal shock reconstructed from multi-vantage remote-sensing produces a longitudinal SEP intensity distribution at multiple observers that is consistent with the shock's local θ_Bn / Mach number across longitude.

skills.title: Increased and Varied Radiation during the Sun's Encounters with Cold Clouds in the last 10 million years
skills.core_claim: During the Sun's encounters with cold interstellar clouds, modeled GCR/ACR conditions at Earth differ substantially from quiet-Sun reference, with implications for radiation history.

skills.title: Solar Energetic Proton Events Observed by the High Energy Telescopes on the STEREO Spacecraft or at the Earth During the First Solar Orbit of STEREO A (2006 to 2023)
skills.core_claim: A 2006–2023 SEP proton catalog from STEREO-A HET (and Earth observers) covering STEREO-A's first complete solar orbit serves as a stable observational baseline for longitudinal coverage and event statistics.

skills.title: Physics-Guided Counterfactual Explanations for Large-Scale Multivariate Time Series: Application in Scalable and Interpretable SEP Event Prediction
skills.core_claim: A physics-guided counterfactual explanation framework on multivariate time series identifies which input features (solar wind / radio / X-ray) drive a SEP prediction, improving scalability and interpretability over black-box ML.

skills.title: Solar Energetic Particle Forecasting with Multi-Task Deep Learning: SEPNET
skills.core_claim: SEPNET is a multi-task deep-learning model that simultaneously predicts SEP-event occurrence, peak proton flux, and spectral index, outperforming single-task baselines on a hold-out catalog.

skills.title: The Extent of Solar Energetic Particle Irradiation in the Sun's Protoplanetary Disk
skills.core_claim: Modeling of SEP irradiation in the young Sun's protoplanetary disk constrains the radial extent over which energetic particles can drive isotopic anomalies (e.g. 10Be) under plausible early-Sun activity scaling.

skills.title: Coronal flux tube illuminated by strong shock spot: New Year's Eve solar eruption of 2023-Dec-31
skills.core_claim: The 2023-12-31 eruption produced a localized 'shock spot' that illuminated a coronal flux tube, identified through coordinated remote-sensing and in-situ + radio diagnostics.

skills.title: Parallel and perpendicular diffusion of energetic particles in the near-Sun solar wind observed by Parker Solar Probe
skills.core_claim: PSP in-situ energetic-particle observations constrain parallel and perpendicular diffusion coefficients in the near-Sun solar wind, providing the κ_perp/κ_par ratio at heliocentric distances closer than previously sampled.

skills.title: Energy-dependent SEP Fe/O abundances during the May 2024 superstorm
skills.core_claim: SEP Fe/O abundance ratios during the May 2024 superstorm show characteristic energy dependence that reflects the compound nature of the driver and shock-acceleration of suprathermal seed populations.

skills.title: Evolution of the Shock Properties of the 2023 March 13 Event from In-Situ and Remote-Sensing Data
skills.core_claim: In-situ + remote-sensing data for 2023-03-13 yield a time-resolved evolution of the shock's local θ_Bn, Mach number, and surface geometry, complementing the widespread-event ESP analysis of Dresing+ 2025.

skills.title: Multispacecraft Observations of the 2024 September 9 Backside Solar Eruption that Resulted in a Sustained Gamma Ray Emission Event
skills.core_claim: The 2024-09-09 backside eruption produced a sustained gamma-ray emission event whose source-region observers are limb-occluded for Earth-side instruments; multispacecraft data trace the eruption + shock evolution.

skills.title: Third Harmonic Structure in an Interplanetary Type II Radio Burst and Other Energetic Phenomena During the 2024 September 14 Solar Eruption
skills.core_claim: An interplanetary type II radio burst from the 2024-09-14 eruption shows a third-harmonic structure (in addition to the fundamental + 2nd harmonic), a rare regime for IP type IIs.

skills.title: Radial dependence of ion fluences in the 2023 July 17 SEP event from Parker Solar Probe to STEREO and ACE
skills.core_claim: The 2023-07-17 SEP event observed simultaneously at PSP, STEREO and ACE yields a power-law radial fluence dependence across heliocentric distance.

skills.title: Electron Beam Propagation and Radio-Wave Scattering in the Inner Heliosphere using Five Spacecraft
skills.core_claim: Multilateration with five spacecraft (PSP, STEREO-A, Wind, Solar Orbiter, Mars Express) for the 2021-12-04 event traces type III radio sources along a Parker spiral (~493 km/s) and quantitatively reconciles 'higher than expected' electron densities with radio-wave scattering.

skills.title: Shock and SEP Modeling Study for the 5 September 2022 SEP Event
skills.core_claim: The 2022-09-05 SEP event is modeled by coupling a shock-propagation simulation with a SEP transport solver and the resulting intensity profile reproduces the observed PSP near-Sun + 1 au profiles within tolerance.

skills.title: Composition variation of the May 16 2023 Solar Energetic Particle Event observed by Solar Orbiter and Parker Solar Probe
skills.core_claim: PSP and SOLO at similar radial distance (~0.7 au) but ~60° apart in longitude observe the 2023-05-16 SEP event: PSP sees Fe-rich (Fe/O ≈ 0.48), SOLO Fe-poor (Fe/O ≈ 0.08); He/H also differs by ~2×; spectra fit Band function; differences persist throughout event suggesting direct flare contribution at PSP.

skills.title: Kappa-tail technique: Modeling and application to Solar Energetic Particles observed by Parker Solar Probe
skills.core_claim: The kappa-tail technique provides a closed-form fit to the high-energy tail of a kappa distribution and is applied to PSP/IS☉IS energetic-particle spectra to extract κ, T_EP, n_EP.

skills.title: Three-stage Acceleration of Solar Energetic Particles Detected by Parker Solar Probe
skills.core_claim: PSP IS☉IS observations reveal a three-stage acceleration sequence (flare, shock, reservoir) within a single SEP event, with characteristic spectral / compositional signatures separable across the event timeline.

skills.title: Bidirectional anisotropic solar energetic particle events observed by Solar Orbiter
skills.core_claim: Solar Orbiter observes bidirectional anisotropic SEP events whose dual streaming components indicate either mirror-reflection or trapping inside a magnetic structure.

skills.title: Resolving spatial and temporal shock structures using LOFAR observations of type II radio bursts
skills.core_claim: LOFAR resolves type II band splitting and herringbone fine structure that map onto distinct shock locations / acceleration sites at the coronal shock front.

skills.title: Towards advanced forecasting of solar energetic particle events with the PARASOL model
skills.core_claim: The PARASOL SEP-forecast model couples solar-eruption inputs with a transport solver to deliver event-time forecasts of SEP intensity and spectrum, with verification on a hold-out set.

skills.title: Cross-Field Diffusion Effects on Particle Transport in a Solar Coronal Flux Rope
skills.core_claim: Cross-field diffusion inside a coronal flux rope produces a measurable spread of energetic-particle distributions across field lines, with implications for ICME magnetic-cloud particle observations.

skills.title: Energetic Particles from Quasi-Separatrix Layers and Current Sheets at the Sun
skills.core_claim: Energetic-particle acceleration at QSLs and current sheets is identified as an additional component contributing to impulsive SEP events.

skills.title: Radial Evolution of ICME-Associated Particle Acceleration Observed by Solar Orbiter and ACE
skills.core_claim: ICME-associated particle acceleration measured at Solar Orbiter and ACE during radial conjunctions traces the radial evolution of the driving shock.

skills.title: A catalog of multi-vantage point observations of type-II bursts: Statistics and correlations
skills.core_claim: A multi-vantage-point catalog of type II radio bursts (Wind/STEREO/PSP/SOLO) provides population-level statistics and correlations between type II properties and source-event parameters.

skills.title: Radiation doses during extreme solar energetic particle events
skills.core_claim: Radiation-dose estimates at aviation altitudes and in space for both Space Age extreme events and historical (cosmogenic-radionuclide-inferred) events are computed under worst-case assumptions.

skills.title: Signatures of localised particle acceleration at a global coronal shock wave
skills.core_claim: A global coronal shock wave shows localized particle-acceleration signatures (e.g. type II 'spots', SEP onsets) that map onto specific places along the shock surface.

skills.title: Numerical investigation of particle acceleration at interplanetary shocks: diffusive and superdiffusive scenarios
skills.core_claim: Numerical simulations of particle acceleration at IP shocks compare standard diffusive DSA with superdiffusive (anomalous) transport scenarios and identify observable signatures distinguishing them.

skills.title: Inverse Velocity Dispersion of Solar Energetic Protons Observed by Solar Orbiter and Its Shock Acceleration Explanation
skills.core_claim: A Solar Orbiter SEP event exhibits inverse velocity dispersion that is explained by a time-dependent shock-acceleration model.

skills.title: Evidence of Time-Dependent Diffusive Shock Acceleration in the 2022 September 5 Solar Energetic Particle Event
skills.core_claim: The 2022-09-05 Labor Day SEP event shows direct evidence for time-dependent diffusive shock acceleration in the PSP near-Sun observations, with progressive spectral hardening matching the model.

skills.title: Effect of interplanetary shock waves on turbulence parameters
skills.core_claim: IP shocks modify the upstream/downstream turbulence parameters (spectral index, anisotropy, compressive fraction), and the modification correlates with shock parameters.

skills.title: Multi-spacecraft constraints on relativistic solar energetic particle transport in the widespread 28 October 2021 event
skills.core_claim: Multi-spacecraft observations of the 2021-10-28 widespread SEP event constrain relativistic-proton transport parameters across heliolongitude.

skills.title: Connection-angle dependence of proton anisotropy in ground-level enhancement events
skills.core_claim: Proton anisotropy in GLE events correlates with magnetic-connection angle between the observer and the source region.
